meta.name: 吉林大学前卫南区
meta.projection: EPSG:32651; local x=easting-origin.easting, y=origin.northing-northing; units metres; no display rotation
meta.filtering: Buildings kept when representative point is inside campus. Roads/barriers/surfaces/water geometries clipped to boundary. Polygon holes retained. Tagged POIs filtered to campus. All original topology and OSM tags remain in raw snapshots.
warnings: OSM is a volunteer map; element counts are not coverage estimates.
Missing floor/height fields are not inferred measurements.
Door nodes are building entrances, not necessarily campus gates.
No barrier ways does not mean no real walls.
Road access, construction and steps tags must be respected by navigation.
Decorative assets generated by the application are artistic, not surveyed.
